text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Symboli Kris S is in the lead!! Symboli 
Kris S in front!! Symboli Kris S crosses 
the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Truly a magnificent battle of blood and 
spirit...! My throbbing heartbeat is proof 
of that...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is none other than—my destiny!!! The 
vanguard of the rebel warriors!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!! The God of Destruction shall 
awaken time and again. As long as your 
souls shine bright—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Next time," I will crush you. And you 
will remember.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To see who can make you the most 
intoxicated.
